zh-CN.title: 广场红点与唱片铺新规则
items: 探索、好友、活动标签分别提示新内容。新活动和有待领取奖励的活动卡片也会显示红点。
回声唱片铺换上了黑胶唱片横幅。分享歌曲不限歌手，听完歌曲可按歌手和播放版本获得积分。
奖池可预览歌手气泡及其专辑元素。

en.title: Square Badges and Record Shop Rules
items: Explore, Friends, and Activities now have separate unread dots. Activity cards also show a dot for new events and unclaimed rewards.
Echo Record Shop has a new vinyl-themed banner. Share music by any artist, or earn points for finishing full tracks and previews.
Preview artist bubbles and their album decorations in the prize pool.
